notes: SSP series are spliced: RCMIP 'historical' for 1750-2014, the SSP row from 2015 (identical to RCMIP's own SSP rows before 2015 for concentrations). 'historical' entries are null after 2014. Emissions in GtCO2/yr (RCMIP Mt CO2/yr / 1000); SSP emissions are native only at rcmip.emissions_native_years after 2014 and linearly interpolated in between. ERF in W/m2 (total includes natural solar+volcanic).
